data.body: ROOT CAUSE of the agent-pass wedge (task #185): a model-facing tool name must match [A-Za-z0-9_-] in <=64 bytes (capability-host valid_tool_name, enforced by validate_tool_request). The native-ComfyUI task gave a workflow tool the Settings DISPLAY name ("Krea-2 Turbo Text to Image (Upscaled)"), so every request carrying it was invalid: the pass never reached its first model call and the failure-policy retry loop pinned one core for 18 minutes with no writes. MCP names were already sanitised. FIX: comfyui_provider_name(tool_id) = mcp_provider_name("comfyui","comfyui",tool_id), plus provider_name_is_valid as the shared contract and a regression test. Each pass re-resolves tools from Settings, so existing Chats recover. STILL OPEN: a rejected request must surface and stop, not retry hot.
